```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_p": (8.0, 5.0, 14.0),
    "Lp":     (0.3, 0.15, 0.6),
    "Lea":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "It0":    (6e-6, 3e-6, 10e-6),
    "Iab0":   (4e-6, 2e-6, 8e-6),
    "Cs":     (15e-12, 5e-12, 40e-12),
    "Ks":     (200.0, 100.0, 500.0),
    "at":     (3.0, 0.5, 6.0),
    "ax":     (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),
    "Idiv":   (2e-6, 1e-6, 5e-6),
    "Cff":    (2e-12, 0.5e-12, 10e-12),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VIN = 1.8
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6); vo = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    Imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3); Imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 1e-9); Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Ks, at, ax = p["Ks"], p["at"], p["ax"]
    It0, Iab0, Cs, Idiv = p["It0"], p["Iab0"], p["Cs"], p["Idiv"]

    def solve_vgs(dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
        lo, hi = 0.1, 1.8
        for _ in range(45):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if abs(lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"]) < Id:
                lo = mid
            else:
                hi = mid
        v = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        return v, lut.op(dev, W, L, v, vds, vsb)

    # ---------------- bias network ----------------
    Ipb, Ibw = 2e-6, 1e-6
    mb0 = lut.size("n", 8, 2.0, Iref, vds=0.75)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", 8, 2.0, Iref, vds=mb0.vgs)
    vbn = mb0.vgs
    mb1 = lut.size("n", 8, 2.0, Ipb, vds=0.9)
    mpd = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, Ipb, vds=0.85)
    mpd = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, Ipb, vds=mpd.vgs)
    mpw = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, Ibw, vds=1.3)
    mbw = lut.size("n", 22, 2.0, Ibw, vds=0.45)
    mbw = lut.size("n", 22, 2.0, Ibw, vds=mbw.vgs)

    # ---------------- pass + sense ----------------
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Imax, vds=VIN - vo)
    Is_max = Imax / Ks
    ms = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Is_max, vds=VIN - vo)
    msd = lut.size("n", 20, 2.0, Is_max, vds=0.5)
    msd = lut.size("n", 20, 2.0, Is_max, vds=msd.vgs)
    mta = lut.size("n", 20, 2.0, at * Is_max, vds=0.15)
    mxa = lut.size("n", 20, 2.0, ax * Is_max, vds=0.2)
    mna = lut.size("n", 20, 2.0, ax * Is_max, vds=0.8)
    mpa = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, ax * Is_max, vds=0.85)
    mpa = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, ax * Is_max, vds=mpa.vgs)

    # ---------------- error amplifier ----------------
    Itail_max = It0 + at * Is_max
    Iside_max = 0.5 * Itail_max
    vtail = 0.12
    for _ in range(3):
        mi = lut.size("n", 20, p["Lea"], Iside_max, vds=0.6, vsb=vtail)
        vtail = max(0.08, vref - mi.vgs)
    ml = lut.size("p", 12, p["Lea"], Iside_max, vds=0.9)
    ml = lut.size("p", 12, p["Lea"], Iside_max, vds=ml.vgs)
    mt0 = lut.size("n", 22, 2.0, It0, vds=vtail)

    # ---------------- class-AB common-gate stack ----------------
    Iab_mid = Iab0 + 0.5 * ax * Is_max
    vs1 = 0.25
    for _ in range(4):
        mx = lut.size("n", 20, 0.5, Iab_mid, vds=0.45, vsb=vs1)
        vs1 = vbn - mx.vgs
    my = lut.size("p", 14, 0.5, Iab_mid, vds=0.5)
    vs2 = vref + my.vgs
    mx0 = lut.size("n", 22, 2.0, Iab0, vds=max(vs1, 0.12))
    my0 = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, Iab0, vds=max(VIN - vs2, 0.2))

    # ---------------- netlist ----------------
    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MB1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpd)
    n.dev("MPW", "nbw", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpw)
    n.dev("MBW", "nbw", "nbw", "vss", "vss", mbw)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "fb", "tail", "vss", mi)
    n.dev("M2", "g", "vref", "tail", "vss", mi)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vin", "vin", ml)
    n.dev("M4", "g", "d1", "vin", "vin", ml)
    n.dev("MT0", "tail", "nbw", "vss", "vss", mt0)
    n.dev("MTA", "tail", "sn", "vss", "vss", mta)
    mpm = max(1, min(200, int(math.ceil(mp.W / 60.0))))
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", mp, m=mpm)
    n.dev("MS", "sn", "g", "vin", "vin", ms)
    n.dev("MSD", "sn", "sn", "vss", "vss", msd)
    n.dev("MY0", "s2", "pb", "vin", "vin", my0)
    n.dev("MNA", "pa", "sn", "vss", "vss", mna)
    n.dev("MPA", "pa", "pa", "vin", "vin", mpa)
    n.dev("MYA", "s2", "pa", "vin", "vin", mpa)
    n.dev("MY", "g", "vref", "s2", "s2", my)
    n.dev("MX", "g", "ibias", "s1", "vss", mx)
    n.dev("MX0", "s1", "nbw", "vss", "vss", mx0)
    n.dev("MXA", "s1", "sn", "vss", "vss", mxa)
    n.C("CS1", "vout", "s1", Cs)
    n.C("CS2", "vout", "s2", Cs)
    R2 = vref / Idiv
    R1 = R2 * (vo / vref - 1.0)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    n.C("CFF", "vout", "fb", p["Cff"])

    # ---------------- first-order predictions ----------------
    beta = vref / vo
    Gdiv = 1.0 / (R1 + R2)
    Ip_l = Imin + Idiv
    vsg_l, opl = solve_vgs("p", mp.W, mp.L, Ip_l, VIN - vo)
    vsg_h = mp.vgs
    gm_pl, gds_pl = abs(opl["gm"]), abs(opl["gds"])
    gm_ph, gds_ph = mp.gm, mp.gds

    Is_l = Ip_l / Ks
    Iside_l = 0.5 * (It0 + at * Is_l)
    _, oil = solve_vgs("n", mi.W, mi.L, Iside_l, 0.6, vtail)
    _, oll = solve_vgs("p", ml.W, ml.L, Iside_l, 0.9)
    gm1_l = abs(oil["gm"]); A1_l = gm1_l / (abs(oil["gds"]) + abs(oll["gds"]))
    gm1_h = mi.gm;          A1_h = mi.gm / (mi.gds + ml.gds)

    Ap_l = gm_pl / (gds_pl + Gdiv); Ap_h = gm_ph / (gds_ph + Gdiv)
    T0_l = beta * A1_l * Ap_l;      T0_h = beta * A1_h * Ap_h
    Cc = 2 * Cs
    CG = abs(mp.cgg) + abs(ms.cgg) + abs(mx.cdd) + abs(my.cdd) + abs(mi.cdd) + abs(ml.cdd)
    ugf_l = beta * gm1_l / (2 * PI * Cc)
    ugf_h = beta * gm1_h / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2_l = gm_pl * Cc / (CG * CL) / (2 * PI)
    pcg_l = mx.gm * (Iab0 / Iab_mid) / (2 * PI * Cs)
    pm_l = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_l / p2_l)) - 2 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugf_l / max(pcg_l, 1)))

    def psrr(T0, ugf, gds):
        f = 1e3
        T1k = T0 / math.sqrt(1 + (f * T0 / ugf) ** 2)
        fol = gds / abs(complex(gds + Gdiv, 2 * PI * f * CL))
        return 20 * math.log10((1 + T1k) / fol)
    psrr_l = psrr(T0_l, ugf_l, gds_pl); psrr_h = psrr(T0_h, ugf_h, gds_ph)

    dVg = abs(vsg_h - vsg_l)
    A1_avg = math.sqrt(A1_l * A1_h)
    load_reg = dVg / (beta * A1_avg) / (Imax - Imin)
    line_reg = max((gds_ph / (gds_ph + Gdiv)) / (1 + T0_h), (gds_pl / (gds_pl + Gdiv)) / (1 + T0_l))
    iq = Iref + Ipb + Ibw + It0 + Iab0 + Idiv + Is_l * (1 + at + 2 * ax)
    undershoot = dVg * CG / Cs + 0.02
    overshoot = dVg * CG / Cs + 0.03
    vout_err = 100 * (2 * (ml.gds * 0.1) / max(gm1_h, 1e-12)) / vo + 0.1

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err,
        "iq": iq,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "overshoot": overshoot,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "psrr_1k": min(psrr_l, psrr_h),
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "ripple_settled": 0.002,
        "psrr_1k_heavy": psrr_h, "psrr_1k_light": psrr_l,
        "T0_light_db": db(T0_l), "T0_heavy_db": db(T0_h),
        "ugf_light": ugf_l, "ugf_heavy": ugf_h, "p2_light": p2_l, "pcg_light": pcg_l,
        "pm_light_deg": pm_l, "C_gate": CG, "W_pass": mp.W,
        "v_s1": vs1, "v_s2": vs2, "v_tail": vtail, "dVg": dVg,
    }
```
